findings.detail: Private credit rows have a source Reference Rate and Spread value, but the extracted row-validation artifact reports blank interest_rate and no basis_spread.

rationale: X02 fired because PRIVATE_CREDIT rows have neither interest_rate nor basis_spread in the extracted holdings data. The raw SOI table has a Reference Rate and Spread column and affected debt rows show explicit spreads such as S + 4.50 %, S + 5.00 %, and S + 5.38 % (includes 2.88 % PIK). The missing extracted rate/spread is therefore a real extraction gap, not a false alarm. No aggregate anchor was needed for this row-level rate-field defect.
